item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory findings that establish the predicate for imposing the import fees; the legally consequential determination occurs in this segment rather than through a later agency decision.","evidence":"I find and declare that"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently continues and amends the tariff-schedule headnote, establishing binding fee formulas and adjustment rules effective the following day; the Secretary's later calculations implement that present legal act.","evidence":"Headnote 4 of part 3 of the Appendix to the TSUS is continued in effect and amended"},{"segment_id":"3","code":2,"rationale":"The segment requires the Secretary to determine, announce, certify, and publish the quarterly fees later, at which point the applicable fee amounts are administratively produced.","evidence":"The Secretary shall determine the amount of the quarterly fees"},{"segment_id":"4","code":3,"rationale":"Although it includes ministerial duties for later adjustments, the segment itself amends the tariff schedule's rates and directly prescribes when adjusted fees apply and which shipments are exempt.","evidence":"the \"Rates of Duty (Section 22 Fees)\" are amended to read as follows"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretary must conduct a quarterly interagency review of the fee system, an internal executive oversight function that does not itself alter fees or legal rights.","evidence":"shall review the fee system established by this Proclamation on a quarterly basis"},{"segment_id":"6","code":3,"rationale":"Alongside an internal recommendation duty, the segment directly establishes automatic termination of the proclamation upon the specified Federal Register filing, so the prescribed event itself ends its legal operation.","evidence":"The provisions of this proclamation shall terminate upon the filing of a notice in the Federal Register"},{"segment_id":"7","code":3,"rationale":"The President directly terminates the prior proclamation, preserves specified existing fees and a stabilization price, and sets the effective date and covered entries for this proclamation.","evidence":"The provisions of Proclamation 4940 of May 5, 1982, are hereby terminated"}]}
